summary: Frontend-only UI testing of Pro Photo Sorter Iteration 8 (Light Palette theme, Recent Folders dropdowns, Session Stats strip). All 12 requested test items PASSED via Playwright on the public preview URL. Trash/delete flow and FSA folder pickers skipped per instructions (require human directory-picker + loaded photos). Zero console errors across load, theme toggles, dropdowns, Settings open/save, and reload.

issues: .kbd class in /app/frontend/src/index.css:204 hardcodes background: rgba(0,0,0,0.35) with color var(--text-dim). In Earth Light the chip renders as a dark box with near-invisible brown text (visible on Store 'S' keycap, Delete 'Del', Skip 'Space', and the 'press [S] to store' empty-state hint). Should use a theme variable (e.g. var(--bg-deep)/var(--surface-hover)) so it inverts with the palette.
Strip text uses --text-dim (#7a6a58) on --bg-deep (#ebe1d3) at 10-11px, giving ~3.4:1 contrast (below WCAG AA 4.5:1 for small text). Consider darker dim token for light theme.

action_items: Theme .kbd chip background with a CSS variable instead of hardcoded rgba(0,0,0,0.35) so keycaps stay legible in Earth Light.
Optional: darken --text-dim for light theme (or bump Session Stats font size) to meet AA contrast.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is ~1800+ lines — well over the 700-line guideline; extract toolbar, filmstrip, and destination pane into separate components.
toggle-theme button has only a title attribute; add aria-label for screen readers.
index.css light overrides are complete for variables, but hardcoded rgba/black utilities (.kbd, pane box-shadow) are not theme-aware.
seed_data_creation: None. Test wrote settings.theme='light' into localStorage key pps.state.v2 during Settings-save verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified in Iter 8 run: toggle-theme flips data-theme dark<->light with Sun<->Moon icon swap and --bg #1a1715 <-> #f5efe6; Settings Appearance (theme-dark/theme-light) persists to localStorage pps.state.v2.settings.theme and survives reload; recent-source-toggle/recent-dest-toggle open their menus with 'None yet — pick a folder to add one.' and close on outside click; session-stats-strip sits above filmstrip (y 881 vs 906) with all 6 counters at 0 and session-stats-reset absent when total=0; Iter 7 Batch Behavior testids all still present. NOTE: localStorage may now hold theme='light' — reset if a dark-default test is needed. Untested (needs human FSA picker): recent-folder item selection, .pps-trash move/undo flow, batch delete.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. The light-theme legibility issue is caused by .kbd using a hardcoded black-alpha background that does not participate in the [data-theme='light'] variable overrides.
